description: Fetch one Safe Rate published page by its document id. Returns plain text carrying its own as-of date, canonical URL, data license, and citation notice. Rate index pages are indicative and refreshed daily; they are not a quote for a specific borrower.

id.description: A document id from `search`, e.g. "local/austin-city-tx/mortgage-rates" or "lenders/velocio-mortgage".

name: fetch
title: Read a Safe Rate page
